source: TALE-DNA binding protein-binding microarray (Rogers et al. Nat Commun 2015 DOI 10.1038/ncomms8440; GEO GSE56978 sample GSM1372480 single TALE TAL2009 + platform GPL18593); 每 probe 60bp DNA (GPL18593 SEQUENCE) + VALUE (GSM1372480 normalized Alexa-488 signal intensity, replicate spots averaged by sequence); single-mechanism = TALE RVD-DNA target-site recognition/occupancy
physical_model: per-position additive PWM (paper median R^2=0.959 predicting 60bp probe signal; SIFTED full-context leave-one-TALE-out 0.877) -- fitted here as ridge over positional mononucleotide indicators, near-complete model
cannot_claim: probes are a diverse target-site substitution library (36 variable positions, 12-17 subs from consensus) -> global composition varies little; the informative additive model is POSITIONAL (per-position mononucleotide = PWM), used as the near-complete physical baseline
readout = relative PBM Alexa-488 signal (narrow dynamic range, sd 0.23 in log10), not absolute Kd; single TALE (TAL2009)
higher-order = adjacent variable-position DINUCLEOTIDE non-additivity; tests whether structure crosses beyond the near-complete additive PWM
replicate spots averaged by identical sequence (prevents replicate leakage); held-out CV on unique probes
NEW modality = engineered protein-DNA binding (TALE PBM); registry-unmined; near-complete-model discriminating case for the completeness rule (predicts FAILS)
